title: Voice pronunciation independent review — reconstructed execution summary

reconstruction.reason: The executor became unavailable after the review and executions.
reconstruction.statement: This document reconstructs the finite results and hashes preserved in the review conversation. It is not a recreated raw log, not a fresh execution after environment loss, and not a replacement for unavailable original receipts.

source_binding.original_execution_source: The working pronunciation changes were snapshotted before compiling the independent probes. The original per-file hash manifest was vocabulary-final-receipt.json; its contents are now unavailable, while its printed digest and observed outcomes survive.

uploaded_normalizer.verification_after_loss: Fetched this immutable GitHub blob and independently recomputed SHA-256 in tool-orchestration JavaScript. No executor was used. The coordinator identifies this as the validated unchanged normalizer; this verification alone is not a rerun of the original probes.

directly_observed_native_source.method: Hash printed before compiling the current production source with the cached pinned Flite C tables.

reviewed_asset_pins.classification: Expected SHA-256 pins read from KokoroModelPack and the reviewed fixtures. No asset files were accessible for a new hash verification after executor loss.

real_dictionary_corpus.note: Used the real dictionary through production KokoroLexicon.words as isKnown, rather than a predicate that accepts every word. These are finite probe cases, not 64 JUnit methods.

actual_stream_replay_comparison.method: Appended growing text one character at a time through actual production VoiceSpeechBuffer, then projected its emitted chunks with KokoroSpeechContext. Checked append stability, projection failure state and segment-relative range bounds.
actual_stream_replay_comparison.harness_qualification: Compiled current production source. The auxiliary host test JAR supplied unrelated types; the unchanged actual speechChunks function was extracted from VoiceSession.kt for the probe. This was not Android playback or model inference.

final_dictionary_miss_lts_coverage.method: Freshly compiled production C++ pronunciation code with the pinned Flite CMU LTS C tables; compared every emitted phone with tokens.txt.
final_dictionary_miss_lts_coverage.note: Phone-symbol compatibility does not establish correct acoustic pronunciation.

confirmed_review_repairs: Fraction matching no longer truncates decimal, scientific or identifier denominators: 1/2.5, 1/2e3 and 1/2x retain their complete content.
Titlecase ligature normalization no longer invents the real-dictionary miss split a egir for Ægir.
Compact scientific quantities including 1e3ms and 1e-3m/s² preserve scientific notation.
Unit singular/plural selection uses the complete scientific amount.
GPT-4 is read as g p t four while arithmetic signs are retained.
e.g. and i.e. expand as phrases rather than having their expansion spelled letter by letter.
Ordinary prose superscript footnotes avoid blanket exponent interpretation.
User corrections preserve original displayed term ranges and apply once.

limitations: No physical-phone, Android AudioTrack, acoustic, hardware performance, GPU/NPU, energy or end-to-end JNI/model execution claim.
No full-CI, merge-readiness or release-publication claim.
Context-sensitive homographs remain unchanged; no blanket read/live/lead disambiguation claim.
Some ordinary inflections lack dictionary entries despite a known singular stem. Their LTS stress may differ; nonempty supported phones do not certify natural pronunciation.
Generic formulas and compound units outside explicitly supported forms may retain literal component readings.
The earlier poor fallback prediction for typescript was not a production miss: the full dictionary already contains that word. This correction is retained.
Raw original receipts and per-file manifests cannot be re-fetched from the unavailable executor; historical digests are preserved without fabricating their contents.
